description: Two clusters of two harts each: rocket (scalar) on harts 0-1, rvv on harts 2-3. Each cluster is a single registry core with two harts; XPU-RT treats it as one machine but the runtime uses both harts (1 scheduler worker + 1 pthreadpool helper) for intra-op fanout.

cores.name: rocket_cluster
cores.description: Two scalar harts treated as a single cluster.

cores.name: rvv_cluster
cores.description: Two RVV harts treated as a single cluster.
